ModMetaData.name: AgentTouchFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheepQwQ
ModMetaData.description:
Runtime Harmony fixes for the Android touch port (Waylith engine), no vanilla DLL is modified.
1) Developer tools (LudeonTK DebugTools) work with touch. The port turns every map tap into a synthetic selection (PortUI.MobileSelectionController.Tap) and never produces the MouseDown that DebugTool.DebugToolOnGUI needs, so an armed tool never fires and the tap is stolen by the selector. - PortUI.MobileSelectionController.Tap is skipped while a tool is armed; the tool's clickAction is invoked instead, with UI.MouseCell() pinned to the tapped cell. - Long press cancels the armed tool (touch equivalent of the right mouse button). - RimWorld.Selector.HandleMapClicks is skipped while a tool is armed (real mouse fallback) and a half-open drag box is disarmed so selection can never "stick". - LudeonTK.DebugTool.DebugToolOnGUI is suppressed on the frame a tool already fired through the touch path, so a real mouse event cannot fire the same tool twice.
2) Pointer no longer sticks after a two finger gesture, and a one finger drag no longer turns into a zoom. - Ports1de.TouchGestureEngine.SecondUp leaves state = Ignore and no branch of Move()/Up() handles Ignore, so the finger still on the screen emits nothing until it is lifted and pressed again. The postfix forces state = Idle and drops the pinch baseline / inertia. - RwHost.TouchControls.OnTouch: on ACTION_POINTER_UP / ACTION_CANCEL the engine and the GameCamera accumulators are reset, and the remaining finger is re-armed as a pan (or the remaining two fingers as a pinch) so the gesture continues instead of dying. - Stale GameCamera pan/zoom accumulators are cleared at gesture end, which removes the "leftover zoom applied on the next frame" effect.
Everything is registered with AccessTools and fails soft: a missing target logs one red line ([AgentTouchFix] ...) and the rest of the patches stay active. Nothing is patched permanently outside these six methods.
Requires the mobile port (PortUI/RwHost present). Harmless on desktop RimWorld: the touch-only patches are simply skipped.
